name: RC–B10–0157/2025 – Before § 1 – Am 8
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for EU support towards a just transition and reconstruction in Syria
part_text: -1a. Recalls that Syria has faced a violent operation of interference, subversion and aggression by the United States and other NATO member countries, such as the United Kingdom, France and Turkey, as well as Israel and Gulf countries, which started in 2011;
